raw: {"title":"平抛与斜抛运动纯物理模型","domain":"projectile","model_js":"(function(){const PI=Math.PI;globalThis.coursewareModel=Object.freeze({sample(input){const sc=(input&&input.scenario)||{};const mode=sc.mode||'oblique';const v0=+sc.speed_m_s||0;const thetaRad=((mode==='horizontal'?0:(+sc.angle_deg||0))*PI)/180;const g=+sc.g_m_s2||0;const m=+sc.mass_kg||0;const x0=+sc.x0_m||0;const y0=+sc.y0_m||0;const vx0=v0*Math.cos(thetaRad);const vy0=v0*Math.sin(thetaRad);const times=Array.isArray(input&&input.times_s)?input.times_s:[];let flightTime=0;if(g>0){flightTime=(vy0+Math.sqrt(vy0*vy0+2*g*y0))/g;}else{flightTime=Infinity;}const range=vx0*flightTime;let apexTime=0;if(g>0){apexTime=Math.max(0,vy0/g);}const maxHeight=y0+vy0*apexTime-0.5*g*apexTime*apexTime;const optAngle=(v0>0&&g>0)?45:0;const states=times.map(function(t){const tt=+t||0;let y=y0+vy0*tt-0.5*g*tt*tt;let vy=vy0-g*tt;let vx=vx0;let x=x0+vx0*tt;if(y<0){y=0;vy=vy0-g*flightTime;x=x0+vx0*flightTime;}const v2=vx*vx+vy*vy;const ke=0.5*m*v2;const pe=m*g*y;return{t_s:tt,x_m:x,y_m:y,vx_m_s:vx,vy_m_s:vy,ax_m_s2:0,ay_m_s2:-g,kinetic_j:ke,potential_j:pe,mechanical_j:ke+pe};});return{states:states,events:{flight_time_s:flightTime,range_m:range,apex_time_s:apexTime,max_height_m:maxHeight,optimal_equal_height_angle_deg:optAngle}};}});})();"}
